title: Saudi Arabian Red Onion Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic kebab dish from Saudi Arabia, featuring red onion and spices.
instructions: Preheat the grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the Baharat, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken and onion slices to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the chicken and onion onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the onion is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lemon wedges if desired.
